area: Plaistow Level east of Manor Road: open marsh with fences and ditches, Merton Road and a new terrace street, sluices
method: sheet; sweep 9 crops at 2x with anchors recorded at opening (r0c0 L A I, r0c1 I S + ditch, r0c2 EAST / S T O, r1c0 MERTON ROAD / ditch fork, r1c1 I S / MERTON ROAD, r1c2 S T O / dotted circle, r2c0 Sluices / MERTON ROAD, r2c1 Sluices / B.M.8·16, r2c2 ..OAD / P.H.); 6x position sheets csA-csD, 8x digit sheet csE, 12x bench-mark sheet csF, 7x csG and nearest csGnn for 6/8, region view regJ (3x) for the reported join; numeric dot centroids; marker sheet. All crops and sheets displayed when opened.
legibility: clear, sparse marsh; sheet tool reports a horizontal join at py ~726 (x 512-1024) but by eye it is the terrace hatching, no join line seen
